evidence: Product's time-varying/interactive surface: instruction.md:5 and :7; hireops_rules.md section 5 ('appears by itself within 15 seconds, with no reload and nothing clicked ... must leave these as they were: text they are typing anywhere, the control that has keyboard focus, a card they have open, the conversation they have open, and how far they have scrolled'); section 6 (Enter/Shift+Enter, opens scrolled to newest, earlier messages keep place, scrolled-up arrival). Every such promise is graded by an instructed interaction or timed wait, not a first paint. (1) Live arrival: functional protocol V (scored/functional/prompt.md:47) 'Without reloading or clicking in this page, wait up to 15 seconds (a wait-for call, or snapshots; accept what is present at the first snapshot at or after 15 seconds)' graded by hro_live_board; protocol U (prompt.md:41) applies the same 15 s no-click wait to hro_unread_counts, hro_seen, hro_unread_scrolled_up; protocol T for hro_msg_exchange ('watch the reply arrive on Rafael's open conversation without reload'). (2) Preservation under update: polish hro_pol_live_board clicks into the note box, types 'Call back on Fri', scrolls the page or board container (adding up to twelve cards if needed), has another context move a card, then checks details still open, exact value, document.activeElement, scroll not reset and typing appends; hro_pol_live_thread does the same for the reply box with Noor's incoming message; scored/polish/prompt.md:14 forbids reload/navigate/click/type in the observed page until the update or 15 s and directs page.evaluate reads of activeElement, field values and scroll offsets. (3) Scroll behaviour: hro_pol_earlier_place measures getBoundingClientRect().top before/after loading earlier messages; hro_thread_latest fails if it 'opens at the top'; hro_unread_scrolled_up scrolls up before arrival. (4) Keyboard/focus: hro_msg_compose Shift+Enter/Enter and post-send focus; hro_refused_put_back requires document.activeElement inside the card. (5) Failure/session states: hro_pol_failed_send aborts one send request or uses setOffline; hro_pol_session_resume ends the session in a second tab then presses Enter. Viewport/theme: instruction.md:11 'We don't need theme switching or a special phone layout'; scored/visual/prompt.md:14 'Assess desktop craft at a conventional desktop viewport. No phone layout or theme switching is required', so resize/toggle legs are correctly N-A and the template's 390x844 responsive_layout criterion is absent consistently with the brief; the brief requires no animation. Gates are static by design (render: sign-in; constraints: create + independent-context readback) and are not interaction rows. Weak-app probes: an app that refreshes only on window focus or click fails V/U (no click allowed); one that re-renders the board closing details or clearing the note fails hro_pol_live_board; one that refreshes counts only on navigation fails hro_unread_counts ('changes only after a reload or navigation'); one that jumps to newest on arrival fails hro_unread_scrolled_up. Conforming alternatives: polling, SSE and sockets are all accepted; an internal scroll container is accepted; non-scrolling layouts are handled by the twelve-card fallback; the 15 s snapshot tolerance avoids one-second timing distinctions. Scripted golden (results/workspace.json group 17 'live board: another person's move arrives without reload; open card, note draft and focus kept', arrival_ms 806; group 18 conversation place/draft/focus/scroll; group 19 Enter/Shift+Enter, live seen/unread; group 21 session end) shows the golden exhibits these behaviours, so the interactions are feasible. Residual (P3 note, not a Fail): the brief says updates must not move 'my cursor'; hro_pol_live_board and hro_pol_live_thread verify focus and that typing appends, but the caret is left at the end of the typed text, so caret preservation mid-text is not distinguished. Risk=true because no full configured judge run exists: raw-evidence-index scope says 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent', so whether the configured judge actually performs these waits and interactions within the 900 s polish budget and 9000 s functional budget (polish needs up to twelve extra cards, several independent contexts, request interception and second-tab sign-out) is unmeasured.
counterexample: Not a Fail. Bounded gap: an app whose live refresh rewrites the focused note/reply textarea value and calls focus() with the caret forced to the end passes hro_pol_live_board and hro_pol_live_thread because the judge's caret is already at the end; a user editing mid-text would see the cursor jump, contrary to instruction.md:5 'without closing the card I have open, wiping the note I am typing or moving my cursor'.
suggested_fix: Optional: in hro_pol_live_board and/or hro_pol_live_thread place the caret mid-text (setSelectionRange inside the typed text) before the remote update and require selectionStart unchanged afterwards. Separately obtain a full configured judge-run transcript showing the 15 s waits and preservation steps were actually performed within budget.
